name: Tangent Audio Bone-Conduction Headband
description:
A slim headband embedded with bone-conduction transducers that deliver audio directly through the skull, leaving the ears completely unobstructed. The band is covered in moisture-wicking fabric and looks like an ordinary athletic headband. Controls are touch-sensitive pads disguised as decorative stitching.

Used by operatives who need comm audio without visible earpieces, athletes who want music without blocking environmental sound, and augmented individuals whose ear canals have been modified in ways that make traditional earbuds impractical.
functionality: Bone-conduction audio, covert comm reception, open-ear design
what_it_says: You're listening to something nobody else can hear, and your ears are still free to catch everything around you.
story_hooks: A dead courier's bone-conduction headband is still receiving transmissions from an encrypted channel — someone is still sending orders to a person who can no longer follow them.

physical_description.visual_profile: A minimalist athletic headband that wraps horizontally across the forehead and temples, sitting just above the eyebrows. Appears completely unremarkable—could pass as standard sports gear. The slim profile creates no visible bulk or protrusion, maintaining a clean, utilitarian aesthetic.
physical_description.fit: Snug but not constrictive; designed to sit flush against the skull with gentle pressure points at the temples where bone-conduction transducers make contact. Elastic stretch fabric allows adjustment for different head sizes without obvious fasteners.
physical_description.primary_material: Technical moisture-wicking synthetic blend (polyester-elastane mix) with embedded ceramic piezoelectric transducers in the temple zones. Inner surface treated with antimicrobial coating.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly textured weave on the outer surface; inner contact points have subtle raised nodules (the transducers) that are barely perceptible through the fabric layer. Overall feels soft and athletic, like premium sports gear.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray base with reflective accent stitching along the front band. Subtle color variations where transducers sit beneath the weave create faint circular impressions. Optional variants in black, matte silver, or deep teal.
physical_description.closures: None—slip-on elastic design. Band tension is self-adjusting through the stretch fabric; no buckles, snaps, or visible clasps.
distinctive_features: Touch-sensitive control pads disguised as decorative stitching patterns along the outer band—activate volume, accept calls, pause
Bone-conduction transducers embedded at temple points, invisible under fabric
Internal conductive mesh for neural-link compatibility (Tier 2+ models)
Moisture-wicking nano-treatment reflects minimal IR signature
Barely-visible Tangent Audio branding stamped in matte finish on one temple
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 premium tech (professional-grade models); Tier 3 accessible variant available through corpo subsidies or second-hand markets
physical_description.cultural_context: Corporate operatives and black-ops teams prefer these for covert communication. Street athletes and augmented individuals use them to maintain situational awareness. Signals tech-savviness and either serious professional intent or commitment to cutting-edge personal augmentation.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually pristine when new; develops minor salt stains and faint compression marks on the temples with regular use. Well-maintained examples show minimal wear; heavily used units may have slightly dulled stitching or fabric pilling near the edges.
